title: Local dimension at a rational point is preserved by field extension
statement: Let k be a field, K/k a field extension [def-pc-field-extension], and f: X \to \operatorname{Spec} k a locally finite type morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let p: \operatorname{Spec} k \to X satisfy f \circ p = \mathrm{id}. Put Y = X \times_{\operatorname{Spec} k} \operatorname{Spec} K [def-pc-fibre-product], with projections a: Y \to X and b: Y \to \operatorname{Spec} K, and let q: \operatorname{Spec} K \to Y satisfy b \circ q = \mathrm{id} and a \circ q = p \circ g, where g is induced by the given field inclusion. If x=p(*) and y=q(*) are the images of the unique points, then the local rings [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] have equal Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]: $\dim \mathcal O_{X,x}=\dim \mathcal O_{Y,y}$, including nonreduced schemes and without any separatedness assumption.

source.place: First proof paragraph of lem-ag-group-identity-local-dimension, rational-point scalar-extension comparison; Stacks Tags 00P4 and 00OU

proof.text: Choose an affine neighbourhood Spec A of x. Local finite type makes A a finite type k-algebra. The inverse image is Spec(A tensor_k K); the projection contracts the prime at y to the prime at x by the equation on q. Both are maximal because the sections identify their residue fields with k and K respectively.
Apply dimension-at-point field extension to the two corresponding primes of A and A tensor_k K. Their topological local dimensions coincide.

At the two maximal ideals, closed-point dimension equals dimension of localization. The affine stalk isomorphisms and invariance of stalks under open immersion identify these localizations with the displayed scheme stalks. Compose the equalities.

proof_origin.place: H1 makes the rational-point comparison in the first paragraph precise using the two stated affine comparisons

theorem ringKrullDim_rationalPoint_field_baseChange
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (p : Spec (.of k) ⟶ X) (hp : p ≫ f = 𝟙 _)
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (q : Spec (.of K) ⟶ pullback f
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))
    (hq : q ≫ pullback.snd f
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) = 𝟙 _)
    (hqp : q ≫ pullback.fst f
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)) ≫ p) :
    ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk (p (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k))) =
      ringKrullDim ((pullback f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).presheaf.stalk
          (q (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K)))
